excluded_gold.title: Using Python’s built-in hash() to build cache keys is non-deterministic across processes (hash randomization), so keys w
excluded_gold.description: Using Python’s built-in hash() to build cache keys is non-deterministic across processes (hash randomization), so keys won’t match across workers and invalidate_upsampling_cache may fail to delete them. Use a deterministic serialization of project_ids for the cache key.

adjudication.why: The hashed value is a sorted tuple of integer project IDs, not strings. Python hash randomization does not randomize integer tuple hashes across processes; both creation and invalidation use the same expression.
The new factory helper uses if client_sample_rate, so a valid 0.0 is not copied into normalized_data. This changes the fixture data rather than merely omitting a test.

missed_correctness_gold.title: The upsampling eligibility check passes the outer dataset instead of the actual dataset used by scoped_dataset. In paths
missed_correctness_gold.description: The upsampling eligibility check passes the outer dataset instead of the actual dataset used by scoped_dataset. In paths where the query ultimately runs against discover (e.g., dashboard split) while the original dataset is metrics, upsampling may be skipped even when all projects are allowlisted.

adjudication.why: The new eligibility call passes the outer dataset even when _get_event_stats receives a different scoped_dataset for a discover dashboard split. The helper gates transformations on that dataset argument.

promotion_candidates.title: `upsampled_count()` drops the `ifNull` default, silently reverting defensive logic
promotion_candidates.description: commit `6ad6fe38` changes `sum(ifNull(sample_weight, 1))` → `sum(sample_weight)`, silently reverting the defensive default. Events without `sample_weight` count as zero instead of one, causing projects to report count() == 0 for all historical error volume.

promotion_candidates.title: Stray `sentry-repo` gitlink committed with no `.gitmodules`
promotion_candidates.description: `6ad6fe38` adds mode 160000 entry `sentry-repo` without `.gitmodules`, causing every fresh clone to get an empty directory and `git submodule update --init` to fail.

promotion_candidates.title: 60s eligibility cache is slower than original and cannot be invalidated
promotion_candidates.description: Cache swaps local dict read for network cache round-trip on every request, making it slower. Functionally non-revertible: when projects are removed from allowlist, endpoint keeps returning upsampled counts for up to 60s per distinct project-subset.

promotion_candidates.title: Negated `!event.type:error` queries misclassified as error-focused
promotion_candidates.description: `_is_error_focused_query` does substring test, so `!event.type:error` (negation) is incorrectly classified as error-focused, causing non-error rows without `sample_weight` to report count as 0.

promotion_candidates.title: Endpoint refactor triples line count with no behavior change
promotion_candidates.description: Replaces two lines with an inert alias and three identical copies of the same `if`/transform in each return branch, creating three places to keep in sync.
